name: Tarantasio
body:
Tarantasio
CR 18

A huge, horned head emerges from the lake’s troubled waters on top of a long, snakelike body. Flames and noxious fumes erupt from its mouth and flared nostrils.

XP 153,600
CE Gargantuan dragon (aquatic)
Init +5; Senses low-light vision, darkvision 60 ft., scent, smokesight; Perception +34; Aura stench (60 ft., DC 30, 15 rounds)

DEFENSE

AC 33, touch 8, flat-footed 31 (+1 Dex +1 dodge, -4 size, +25 natural)
hp 303 (23d12+154)
Fort +20, Ref +16, Will +21
DR 20/magic; Immune disease, fire, paralysis, sleep, poison; SR 29

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 100 ft.
Melee bite +34 (6d6+22/19-20 plus grab), tail slap +29 (4d6+22)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 20 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon (60-ft. cone, 18d8 fire damage, DC 28), capsize, noxious cloud, smoke cloud (20-ft. radius, DC 28), swallow whole (2d6 bludgeoning and 2d6 fire damage + malaria, AC 22, 30 hp)

STATISTICS

Str 40, Dex 12, Con 24, Int 2, Wis 26, Cha 18
Base Atk +23; CMB +42 (+46 grapple); CMD 53 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Cleave, Dodge, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Attack (bite), Improved Stench, Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Lunge, Power Attack, Vital Strike
Skills Perception +34, Swim +49
SQ amphibious

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Capsize (Ex)

The tarantasio can attempt to capsize a boat or ship by ramming it as a charge attack and making a CMB check.

The DC of this check is 25, or the result of the boat captain’s Profession (sailor) check, whichever is higher. For each size category larger than the tarantasio’s size, it takes a cumulative –10 penalty on this CMB check.

Noxious Cloud (Su)

Once per day as a standard action, the tarantasio can surround itself with a sickly yellow cloud of decay and disease. This works as plague storm (CL 23), except that all creatures in the area of effect must save or contract malaria. All non-magical, non-sentient plant life within the noxious cloud withers and dies; plant creatures take 1d6 points of damage per round.

Smoke Cloud (Ex)

Instead of breathing fire, the tarantasio can release a choking cloud of smoke. This cloud is equivalent to that of pyrotechnics and lasts 1 minute. Creatures immune to fire are immune to the effects of this ability.

Smokesight (Su)

The tarantasio can see through fire, fog, and smoke without penalty.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate lakes and swamps
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

Related to linnorms according to some scholars, or to sea serpents according to others, the tarantasio haunts peaceful lakes in the woods. People deem it responsible for persistent fog banks, epidemics, and rotting plants in the whole region around its den. They spend most of their time underwater, but when prey approaches their huge, horned head emerges from the lake’s troubled waters on top of a long, snakelike body, with flames and noxious fumes erupting from its mouth and flared nostrils.
